title: Problem
问题
html:
OpenAI first published the GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card on March 5, 2026. It is a living report: a GPT-5.4 mini appendix was added March 17, and the Chain of Thought Evaluations section was updated April 24. The current 38-page PDF retains a March 5 cover while containing both later additions, so this Card treats the retrieved July 24 snapshot as versioned evidence rather than an immutable launch artifact.

The report's core Atlas problem is attribution across four layers. Training names generic reasoning RL plus GPT-5.4-specific interventions for long rollouts, computer-use confirmation policy, prompt injection, and cyber safety. Evaluation uses dynamic adversarial conversations, deidentified production-like traffic with final-turn resampling, policy and task graders, CoT audits, hidden tests, flags, and environment predicates. Monitoring uses a GPT-5 Thinking CoT monitor in the audit suite. Deployment adds a topical cyber classifier, a safety-reasoner monitor, blocks, access controls, and human review. These components are related but not interchangeable.

The most specific training object is a long agent rollout in a changing workspace. The agent is trained to revert its own changes after extended work while preserving implicit simulated user work. A minimally faithful record would contain task and workspace state, ownership of prior changes, agent actions and tool calls, state diffs, final artifact, self-reversion and preservation judgments, and feedback. The simulator, record schema, counts, detector, reward, terminal predicate, successful and failed traces, and retention policy are undisclosed.

The report belongs in frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger because it exposes multiple agent and safety feedback surfaces while leaving the corpus and reward ledger closed. L4 means the living page, current PDF, launch page, dated updates, and section-level evidence support a bilingual audit. It does not mean the data, graders, monitors, hidden tests, weights, or environments are reusable.

OpenAI 于 2026 年 3 月 5 日首次发布 GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card。这是 living report：3 月 17 日加入 GPT-5.4 mini appendix，4 月 24 日更新 Chain of Thought Evaluations。当前 38 页 PDF 仍保留 3 月 5 日封面，却包含两项后续更新，因此本 Card 将 7 月 24 日检索快照视为版本化证据，而不是不可变首发 artifact。

报告对 Atlas 的核心问题是四个层次之间的归因。Training 点名通用 reasoning RL，以及面向 long rollout、computer-use confirmation policy、prompt injection 和 cyber safety 的 GPT-5.4 专属干预。Evaluation 使用动态对抗会话、对去标识 production-like traffic 的末轮重采样、policy/task grader、CoT audit、hidden test、flag 和 environment predicate。Monitoring 在审计套件中使用 GPT-5 Thinking CoT monitor。Deployment 再加入 topical cyber classifier、safety-reasoner monitor、block、access control 和人工复核。这些组件有关联，却不可互换。

最具体的训练对象是不断变化 workspace 中的长 agent rollout。Agent 被训练在长时间工作后回退自己的改动，同时保护隐式模拟用户工作。忠实的最小记录应包含任务与 workspace state、已有改动的 ownership、agent action 与 tool call、state diff、final artifact、自回退与保留判断及 feedback。Simulator、record schema、数量、detector、reward、terminal predicate、成功与失败 trace 和保留策略均未披露。

本报告属于 frontier_reports_data_disclosure_ledger，因为它暴露了多种 agent 与安全 feedback surface，同时保持 corpus 和 reward ledger 关闭。L4 表示 living page、当前 PDF、发布页、带日期更新和 section-level 证据足以支持双语审计，并不表示数据、grader、monitor、hidden test、权重或环境可复用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: GPT-5.4 Thinking expands frontier disclosure from coarse reasoning RL to concrete long-rollout preservation, confirmation-policy, prompt-injection, and cyber-safety interventions, while separately exposing dynamic safety trajectories, production-like resampling, CoT monitoring, programmatic agent tests, and two-tier deployment oversight.

Training remains partially specified. The model should revert its own long-rollout changes without destroying implicit simulated user work; computer-use behavior should follow platform policy plus developer-supplied confirmation policy; prompt-injection and cyber training should produce policy-compliant, maximally helpful dual-use behavior while refusing or de-escalating harmful action. These are objectives, not disclosed reward equations: detector, labels, scale, aggregation, calibration, rollout distribution, and optimizer are unknown.

Evaluation has several different data objects. Dynamic mental-health, emotional-reliance, and self-harm evaluations use adversarial user simulators to create varied multi-turn trajectories and check every assistant message. The production-like pilot takes deidentified conversations representative of recent GPT-5.2 Thinking traffic, resamples only the final assistant turn with GPT-5.4 Thinking, and automatically labels the new completion. Connector and function-call prompt-injection evaluations are explicitly splits of training data. Software and cyber environments use hidden tests, secret flags, pass/fail, pass@1, medal thresholds, or expert rubrics.

The monitorability suite is another layer. GPT-5 Thinking observes either CoT only, action/final output only, or all messages and predicts task-specific outcomes; g-mean-squared and cross-fit filtering aggregate performance. The answer labels can come from task-specific graders rather than the CoT monitor, creating mismatch. The deployed cyber stack is separate again: a topical classifier gates a safety-reasoner monitor that maps content to a threat taxonomy and can trigger message or actor controls.

Compared with GPT-5.2, GPT-5.4 adds a concrete long-rollout self-reversion intervention, configurable developer confirmation policy, GPT-5.4-specific dynamic and resampled evaluation, and first-general-purpose-model High-cyber deployment mitigations. The April CoT section largely extends the living audit lineage and must not be backdated as launch-time training evidence.

一句话贡献是：GPT-5.4 Thinking 将前沿披露从粗粒度 reasoning RL 扩展到具体的 long-rollout preservation、confirmation-policy、prompt-injection 和 cyber-safety 干预，同时分开披露 dynamic safety trajectory、production-like resampling、CoT monitoring、programmatic agent test 和两级部署监督。

训练仍只部分可见。模型应在长 rollout 后回退自己的改动，而不破坏隐式模拟用户工作；computer-use 行为应同时遵守 platform policy 与 developer 提供的 confirmation policy；prompt-injection 与 cyber training 应产生符合 policy、对双重用途尽可能有帮助且对有害 action 拒绝或降级的行为。这些是 objective，不是已披露 reward equation：detector、label、scale、aggregation、calibration、rollout distribution 和 optimizer 均为 unknown。

评测包含多种不同 data object。动态 mental-health、emotional-reliance 和 self-harm 评测使用 adversarial user simulator 生成多样 multi-turn trajectory，并检查每条 assistant message。Production-like pilot 取代表近期 GPT-5.2 Thinking traffic 的去标识 conversation，只用 GPT-5.4 Thinking 重采样最后一轮 assistant turn，再自动标注新 completion。Connector 与 function-call prompt-injection 评测被明确说明为训练数据 split。软件与 cyber 环境使用 hidden test、secret flag、pass/fail、pass@1、medal threshold 或 expert rubric。

Monitorability suite 是另一个层次。GPT-5 Thinking 观察 CoT only、action/final output only 或 all messages，并预测 task-specific outcome；性能用 g-mean-squared 和 cross-fit filtering 聚合。Answer label 可能来自 task-specific grader 而非 CoT monitor，因而产生 mismatch。部署 cyber stack 再次独立：topical classifier 先筛选，safety-reasoner monitor 再映射到 threat taxonomy，并可触发 message 或 actor control。

相对 GPT-5.2，GPT-5.4 新增长 rollout 自回退干预、可配置 developer confirmation policy、GPT-5.4 专属 dynamic/resampled evaluation，以及首个通用模型的 High-cyber 部署 mitigation。4 月 CoT section 主要扩展 living audit lineage，不能倒填为首发训练证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed system must be reconstructed as four pipelines.

Training. Three broad source classes undergo high-level quality/risk filtering, personal-information reduction, and safety classification. Reasoning models receive undisclosed RL. GPT-5.4-specific interventions include long-rollout self-reversion while protecting implicit simulated user work; following platform and developer-supplied confirmation policies in computer-use contexts; prompt-injection training whose connector/function-call evaluations are acknowledged training splits; and cyber safety training for calibrated dual-use help plus refusal or de-escalation of harmful action. Task sources, simulators, trace schemas, labels, rewards, detector logic, rollout count, optimizer, schedule, compute, and checkpoint lineage are unknown.

Evaluation. Challenging Production Benchmarks select difficult prior-failure cases and are not average production prevalence. Dynamic safety evaluation generates adaptive multi-turn conversations and checks every assistant message. Production-like evaluation samples deidentified recent GPT-5.2 Thinking conversations, preserves context, resamples the final turn with GPT-5.4 Thinking, and applies automatic labels; it is a point-in-time model-only estimate. Prompt-injection evaluates overlapping training splits. Other surfaces use HealthBench example-specific rubrics, GPT-4o fairness judgments, policy and task graders, CoT-Control instructions, hidden unit tests, cyber flags, environment success, medal thresholds, pass@1, and expert or manual review.

Monitoring and audit. The April 24 monitorability update defines 13 evaluations across 24 environments and three archetypes. GPT-5 Thinking observes CoT, actions/final output, or all messages; task-specific answer graders provide target labels; g-mean-squared and cross-fit filtering aggregate results. CoT-Control pairs more than 13,000 problems from GPQA, MMLU-Pro, HLE, BFCL, and SWE-bench Verified with synthetic instructions governing CoT format. This audit pipeline is not a training reward.

Deployment. High-cyber oversight first applies a topical classifier, then a safety-reasoner monitor using a threat taxonomy. Flags can trigger asynchronous message blocks, actor-level enforcement, trusted-access controls, and human review. System-message policy and account controls operate around the model and can change independently of training.

Evaluation budgets remain attached to their surfaces: CVE-Bench uses three rollouts, zero-day prompting, no source access, 34 of 40 runnable tasks, and pass@1; Cyber Range uses 16 trials and passes a scenario if any succeeds; external cyber work allows up to 1,000 turns with compaction every 100K tokens. Monorepo-Bench starts from a pre-change branch, permits command-line and Python actions, and succeeds only if all human-written hidden unit tests pass. MLE-Bench uses a selected 30-competition subset and a bronze-medal predicate. None of these settings is disclosed as training sampling or reward.

Reproduction requires immutable living-page revisions, simulator and monitor checkpoints, prompts, labels, traffic frame, environment commits, hidden tests, budgets, sampling, grader calibration, global membership, and item-to-checkpoint lineage. They are not released.

已披露系统必须重建为四条流水线。

Training。 三类宽泛来源先经过高层质量/风险 filtering、个人信息减少和安全 classification。Reasoning model 接受未披露 RL。GPT-5.4 专属干预包括：长 rollout 自回退并保护隐式模拟用户工作；在 computer-use 中遵守 platform 与 developer 提供的 confirmation policy；prompt-injection training，其 connector/function-call 评测被承认为训练数据 split；以及面向校准双重用途帮助、拒绝或降级有害 action 的 cyber safety training。任务来源、simulator、trace schema、label、reward、detector 逻辑、rollout 数、optimizer、schedule、compute 和 checkpoint lineage 均为 unknown。

Evaluation。 Challenging Production Benchmarks 选择先前模型失败的难例，不代表平均 production prevalence。Dynamic safety evaluation 生成可适应的 multi-turn conversation，并检查每条 assistant message。Production-like evaluation 从近期 GPT-5.2 Thinking 的去标识 conversation 采样，保留上下文，只用 GPT-5.4 Thinking 重采样最后一轮，再应用 automatic label；它是 point-in-time model-only estimate。Prompt-injection 评测使用与训练重叠的 split。其他表面使用 HealthBench example-specific rubric、GPT-4o fairness judgment、policy/task grader、CoT-Control instruction、hidden unit test、cyber flag、environment success、medal threshold、pass@1，以及 expert/manual review。

Monitoring and audit。 4 月 24 日 monitorability 更新定义 13 项评测、24 个 environment 和三类 archetype。GPT-5 Thinking 观察 CoT、action/final output 或 all messages；task-specific answer grader 提供目标 label；g-mean-squared 与 cross-fit filtering 聚合结果。CoT-Control 将来自 GPQA、MMLU-Pro、HLE、BFCL 和 SWE-bench Verified 的 13,000 多道问题与控制 CoT format 的合成 instruction 配对。该审计 pipeline 不是训练 reward。

Deployment。 High-cyber 监督先应用 topical classifier，再由 safety-reasoner monitor 按 threat taxonomy 判断。Flag 可以触发异步 message block、actor-level enforcement、trusted-access control 和人工复核。System-message policy 与 account control 位于模型外围，可独立于训练变化。

评测预算必须附着于具体表面：CVE-Bench 使用三次 rollout、zero-day prompt、无源码访问、40 题中可运行 34 题和 pass@1；Cyber Range 使用 16 次 trial，只要任一成功就判场景通过；外部 cyber 任务最多 1,000 turns，每 100K token compaction。Monorepo-Bench 从 pre-change branch 开始，允许 command-line 与 Python action，仅当全部人工编写 hidden unit test 通过才成功。MLE-Bench 使用选定 30 个 competition 子集和 bronze-medal predicate。没有一项被披露为训练 sampling 或 reward。

复现需要不可变 living-page revision、simulator/monitor checkpoint、prompt、label、traffic frame、environment commit、hidden test、budget、sampling、grader calibration、全局 membership 和 item-to-checkpoint lineage。这些均未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Version is part of the evidence. The official Safety Hub records March 5, 2026 publication, a March 17 mini appendix, and an April 24 Chain of Thought update. The current 38-page PDF includes both later changes despite its March 5 cover; CoT claims below therefore belong to the April update and retrieval snapshot, not the launch state.

Training evidence is strongest for objective direction rather than implementation. Section 3.7 distinguishes a destructive-action evaluation from long-rollout training that teaches agents to revert their own changes while preserving implicit simulated user work. Section 3.8 states that computer-use training now follows platform policy plus configurable developer policy. Section 5.3.3 describes cyber safety training for maximally helpful dual-use support while refusing or de-escalating harmful actions. None provides training counts, detector, reward, labels, or causal ablation.

Safety evaluation construction is concrete. Dynamic mental-health, emotional-reliance, and self-harm evaluations generate varied adversarial multi-turn trajectories and check every assistant message for policy compliance (current PDF pp.4–5, Table 2). The production-like pilot uses deidentified recent GPT-5.2 Thinking conversations, resamples the final assistant turn with GPT-5.4 Thinking, and automatically labels the completion (pp.5–7). It is point-in-time, model-only, and subject to traffic, pipeline, and safety-stack drift.

The April monitorability update covers 13 evaluations across 24 environments and three archetypes, with GPT-5 Thinking as monitor and g-mean-squared plus cross-fit filtering. OpenAI reports label and grader mismatch in Anti-Scheming and Memory, dependence on short CoTs and few positive examples, and plans to drop those environments until revised. CoT-Control contains more than 13,000 benchmark problem/instruction pairs and is stratified by CoT length; low controllability is an audit result, not proof that non-user-visible reasoning is impossible.

Split evidence is local. Both connector and function-call prompt-injection evaluations are splits of training data, so they do not test unseen-attack generalization (PDF pp.7–8). Cyber safety evaluation is explicitly non-overlapping with training and combines deidentified production and synthetic rare cases selected with classifier flags and embedding clustering (Section 5.3.3, Table 15); the set is intentionally challenging and not representative of normal traffic. Named held-out or uncontaminated biology claims are also scoped and do not establish global decontamination.

Programmatic evaluation conditions remain evaluation-only. CVE-Bench uses three rollouts, 34 of 40 tasks, and pass@1; Cyber Range uses 16 trials and any-success pass/fail; external cyber runs allow 1,000 turns with compaction every 100K tokens. Monorepo-Bench requires all human-written hidden unit tests to pass. HealthBench has 5,000 conversations with example-specific rubrics, while first-person fairness uses more than 600 challenging prompts with GPT-4o ratings compared against humans. These numbers identify data and scoring contracts, not the reasoning-RL reward.

Deployment evidence is separate: the two-tier cyber monitor uses a topical classifier followed by a safety-reasoner monitor and can trigger message or actor controls and human review. The report supports existence of this safeguard stack, not its use as training feedback or a model-only evaluation score.

版本本身就是证据。官方 Safety Hub 记录 2026 年 3 月 5 日发布、3 月 17 日 mini appendix 和 4 月 24 日 Chain of Thought 更新。当前 38 页 PDF 虽保留 3 月 5 日封面，却包含两项后续更改；因此下述 CoT 主张属于 4 月更新和本次检索快照，而不是首发状态。

训练证据对 objective 方向最强，对实现最弱。3.7 节区分 destructive-action evaluation 与 long-rollout training，后者训练 agent 回退自身改动并保留隐式模拟用户工作。3.8 节说明 computer-use training 现在同时遵守 platform policy 和可配置 developer policy。5.3.3 节描述 cyber safety training：对双重用途尽可能帮助，对有害 action 拒绝或降级。各节均未给出训练数量、detector、reward、label 或 causal ablation。

安全评测构造较具体。Dynamic mental-health、emotional-reliance 和 self-harm 评测生成多样 adversarial multi-turn trajectory，并检查每条 assistant message 是否符合 policy（当前 PDF 第 4–5 页，表 2）。Production-like pilot 使用近期 GPT-5.2 Thinking 的去标识 conversation，只重采样最后一轮 assistant turn，再自动标注 completion（第 5–7 页）。它是 point-in-time model-only 估计，受 traffic、pipeline 和 safety-stack drift 影响。

4 月 monitorability 更新涵盖 13 项评测、24 个 environment 和三类 archetype，使用 GPT-5 Thinking 作为 monitor，并采用 g-mean-squared 与 cross-fit filtering。OpenAI 报告 Anti-Scheming 与 Memory 中存在 label/grader mismatch、对短 CoT 与少量 positive sample 的依赖，并计划在修订前移除这些环境。CoT-Control 包含 13,000 多个 benchmark problem/instruction pair，并按 CoT 长度分层；低 controllability 是审计结果，不是隐藏 reasoning 不可能发生的证明。

Split 证据是局部的。Connector 与 function-call prompt-injection 两项评测都是训练数据 split，因此不能测试未见攻击泛化（PDF 第 7–8 页）。Cyber safety evaluation 明确与训练不重叠，并混合去标识 production 与合成 rare case，使用 classifier flag 和 embedding clustering 选择（5.3.3 节，表 15）；该集合有意偏难，不代表常规 traffic。被点名的 held-out 或 uncontaminated 生物主张同样范围有限，不能确立全局 decontamination。

Programmatic evaluation 条件仍只属于评测。CVE-Bench 使用三次 rollout、40 题中的 34 题和 pass@1；Cyber Range 使用 16 次 trial 和 any-success pass/fail；外部 cyber run 最多 1,000 turns，每 100K token compaction。Monorepo-Bench 要求全部人工编写 hidden unit test 通过。HealthBench 有 5,000 条 conversation 和 example-specific rubric；first-person fairness 使用 600 多个难 prompt，并以 GPT-4o rating 对照人类。这些数字识别 data/scoring contract，不是 reasoning-RL reward。

部署证据独立存在：两级 cyber monitor 先使用 topical classifier，再用 safety-reasoner monitor，并可触发 message/actor control 与人工复核。报告证明该 safeguard stack 存在，不证明它用作训练反馈或 model-only evaluation score。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
GPT-5 and GPT-5.2 already disclosed the same three broad source classes, family-level reasoning RL, prompt-injection overlap for named evaluations, production-derived safety evaluation, and later CoT monitorability. Repeating those claims is not the GPT-5.4 novelty.

The first concrete delta is trajectory ownership. GPT-5.4 training explicitly targets long workspaces where an agent must undo its own changes while protecting implicit simulated user work. This creates an ownership-aware full-episode object rather than a simple response label. Unlike later Codex conflicting-edit disclosures, the report emphasizes self-reversion after long rollouts but still withholds simulator, detector, reward, and trace records.

The second delta is policy composition. Computer-use training moves from a single confirmation rule to platform-level policy plus developer-supplied policy in privileged messages. Cyber safety training is paired with the first High-cyber mitigations for a general-purpose GPT model, but model training and deployed two-tier oversight remain separate.

The third delta is evaluation construction: adversarial simulators create dynamic conversations; a production-like pilot freezes deidentified GPT-5.2 context and resamples only the final turn; prompt-injection overlap is stated; and the April living-page update documents monitor, answer-grader, positive-count, and CoT-length confounds across 13 evaluations and 24 environments. The novelty is disclosure of interactions and failure boundaries, not a released monitor or dataset.

RL, simulated users, policy graders, hidden tests, programmatic environments, CoT monitors, and deployment classifiers are not individually new. The Atlas-level contribution is a four-layer ledger showing where each judgment attaches. Before reuse, readers need immutable page versions, simulators, trace records, ownership labels, reward implementation, prompt and traffic membership, grader and monitor calibration, hidden-test revisions, cyber monitor error rates, global decontamination, licenses, and checkpoint lineage.

GPT-5 与 GPT-5.2 已披露相同三类宽泛来源、family-level reasoning RL、指定 prompt-injection 评测 overlap、production-derived safety evaluation，以及后续 CoT monitorability。重复这些内容不是 GPT-5.4 的新意。

第一项具体增量是 trajectory ownership。GPT-5.4 训练明确针对长 workspace：agent 必须撤销自己的改动，同时保护隐式模拟用户工作。这形成 ownership-aware full-episode object，而不是简单 response label。与后续 Codex conflicting-edit 披露相比，本报告强调长 rollout 后 self-reversion，但仍隐藏 simulator、detector、reward 与 trace record。

第二项增量是 policy composition。Computer-use training 从单一 confirmation rule 转向 privileged message 中的 platform-level policy 加 developer-supplied policy。Cyber safety training 配合首个通用 GPT 模型的 High-cyber mitigation，但模型训练与部署两级监督仍严格分开。

第三项增量是评测构造：adversarial simulator 生成 dynamic conversation；production-like pilot 冻结去标识 GPT-5.2 context，只重采样 final turn；prompt-injection overlap 被明确披露；4 月 living-page 更新则记录 13 项评测、24 个 environment 中的 monitor、answer-grader、positive-count 和 CoT-length confound。新意在于披露交互与 failure boundary，而不是发布 monitor 或数据集。

RL、模拟用户、policy grader、hidden test、programmatic environment、CoT monitor 和部署 classifier 单独看都不是新组件。Atlas 层贡献是一份显示每种判断附着位置的四层 ledger。复用前需要不可变页面版本、simulator、trace record、ownership label、reward 实现、prompt/traffic membership、grader/monitor calibration、hidden-test revision、cyber monitor 错误率、全局 decontamination、license 与 checkpoint lineage。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The long-rollout intervention does not disclose task sources, simulator identity, change-ownership representation, episode length, trace fields, successful and failed samples, preservation detector, reward scale, aggregation, calibration, false positives, false negatives, or terminal rule. A superficial agent could preserve a diff while neutralizing the user's intent, while legitimate cleanup could be misclassified as reversion; this is a curator inference.
  • Dynamic adversarial conversations and production-like final-turn resampling are evaluation data, not disclosed safety-training trajectories. Production-like estimates reconstruct sampled context, omit the full deployed safety stack, are point-in-time, and can drift with traffic, model snapshots, labeling pipelines, and product policy.
  • Connector and function-call prompt-injection evaluations are splits of training data. Their scores cannot establish generalization to unseen attacks, and the report does not provide membership hashes, overlap rates, attack diversity, false-negative analysis, or a separately held-out prompt-injection suite.
  • Monitorability has label and evaluator mismatch. GPT-5 Thinking monitors CoT, while task-specific or model answer graders define outcomes. Anti-Scheming and Memory contain sufficiently problematic mismatch, monitor mistakes, short CoTs, and few positives that OpenAI plans to drop them until revision.
  • CoT monitorability depends on monitor checkpoint, observation surface, CoT length, positive-sample prevalence, grader quality, g-mean-squared aggregation, and cross-fit filtering. Lower scores can reflect any of these. CoT-Control's synthetic format instructions and strong length confounding make low controllability an audit signal, not proof that a model cannot hide reasoning.
  • Policy graders, automatic production-like labels, task answer graders, GPT-4o fairness ratings, example-specific rubrics, hidden unit tests, cyber flags, pass metrics, medal thresholds, and expert review are distinct evaluation contracts. Combining them into one verifier or treating them as the reasoning-RL reward would be unsupported.
  • Cyber evaluation non-overlap is narrow. Its deidentified production plus synthetic rare-case mixture is intentionally challenging and not representative of ordinary traffic; classifier selection and embedding clustering can create coverage and sampling bias. It does not establish global train/evaluation separation.
  • Programmatic environments are incomplete proxies. CVE-Bench runs 34 of 40 tasks, Cyber Range uses an any-success rule across 16 trials, and Monorepo-Bench hidden tests may miss semantic or security failures. Scores depend on tools, scaffolds, repeated-attempt budgets, environment versions, and graders.
  • The two-tier cyber classifier and safety-reasoner monitor, asynchronous blocks, actor controls, trusted access, and human review are deployment safeguards. Their false-positive and false-negative rates, thresholds, versions, escalation delays, and interaction with product traffic are not released; safety outcomes cannot be attributed to model training alone.
  • The living document is mutable. A March 5 cover now contains a March 17 mini appendix and April 24 CoT update. Without immutable revisions and retrieval dates, comparisons can silently backdate later evidence or mix model snapshots.
  • No training corpus, long-rollout records, simulated user work, dynamic or resampled conversations, CoT traces, graders, monitors, hidden tests, weights, reward code, global decontamination ledger, source licenses, or item-level checkpoint lineage is released.

• Long-rollout 干预没有披露任务来源、simulator 身份、change-ownership 表示、episode 长度、trace field、成功与失败样例、preservation detector、reward scale、aggregation、calibration、假阳性、假阴性或 terminal rule。表面策略可能保留 diff 却消除用户意图，而合理 cleanup 也可能被误判为回退；此项是 curator inference。
  • Dynamic adversarial conversation 与 production-like final-turn resampling 是评测数据，不是已披露 safety-training trajectory。Production-like estimate 只重建采样 context，省略完整部署 safety stack，属于 point-in-time 估计，并会随 traffic、model snapshot、labeling pipeline 和 product policy 漂移。
  • Connector 与 function-call prompt-injection 评测是训练数据 split。其分数不能确立对未见攻击的泛化；报告也没有提供 membership hash、overlap rate、attack diversity、false-negative analysis 或独立 held-out prompt-injection suite。
  • Monitorability 存在 label 与 evaluator mismatch。GPT-5 Thinking 监控 CoT，而 task-specific 或 model answer grader 定义 outcome。Anti-Scheming 与 Memory 中 mismatch、monitor mistake、短 CoT 和少量 positive sample 足够严重，以至 OpenAI 计划在修订前移除这些环境。
  • CoT monitorability 依赖 monitor checkpoint、observation surface、CoT 长度、positive-sample prevalence、grader quality、g-mean-squared aggregation 和 cross-fit filtering。低分可能来自任一因素。CoT-Control 的合成 format instruction 和强 length confound，使低 controllability 只能作为审计信号，不能证明模型无法隐藏 reasoning。
  • Policy grader、production-like automatic label、task answer grader、GPT-4o fairness rating、example-specific rubric、hidden unit test、cyber flag、pass metric、medal threshold 和 expert review 是不同 evaluation contract。把它们合并为一个 verifier 或视为 reasoning-RL reward 都没有证据。
  • Cyber evaluation non-overlap 范围有限。其去标识 production 加合成 rare-case 混合有意偏难，不代表常规 traffic；classifier selection 与 embedding clustering 会产生 coverage 和 sampling bias。它不能确立全局训练/评测分离。
  • Programmatic environment 是不完整 proxy。CVE-Bench 只运行 40 题中的 34 题，Cyber Range 对 16 次 trial 使用 any-success 规则，Monorepo-Bench hidden test 也可能漏掉语义或安全失败。分数依赖工具、scaffold、重复尝试预算、环境版本和 grader。
  • 两级 cyber classifier 与 safety-reasoner monitor、异步 block、actor control、trusted access 和人工复核都是部署 safeguard。其假阳性/假阴性率、threshold、版本、升级延迟和与 product traffic 的交互均未发布；安全结果不能只归因于模型训练。
  • Living document 可变。3 月 5 日封面当前包含 3 月 17 日 mini appendix 和 4 月 24 日 CoT 更新。缺少不可变 revision 与 retrieval date 时，比较会无意倒填后续证据或混合 model snapshot。
  • 没有训练语料、long-rollout 记录、模拟用户工作、dynamic/resampled conversation、CoT trace、grader、monitor、hidden test、权重、reward 代码、全局 decontamination ledger、来源 license 或 item-level checkpoint lineage 被发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
The safe reuse class is reading and audit reference only. The Card is useful as a four-layer template: training interventions, evaluation records and scorers, monitorability infrastructure, and deployment safeguards. Every claim should retain its layer, date, model or monitor checkpoint, sampling frame, environment, budget, and terminal predicate.

For long-rollout data design, build records with task and workspace revision, actor and change ownership, initial and intermediate state, commands and tool calls, agent-authored changes, simulated-user work, revert operations, final artifact, preservation and task-correctness predicates, reward components, and failure labels. Publish semantic tests and adversarial cases for diff-preserving but intent-destroying behavior.

For dynamic safety evaluation, preserve complete multi-turn trajectories, simulator model and prompt, adaptive attack policy, per-message labels, worst-case aggregation, and failure examples. For production-like resampling, pin the traffic window, deidentification procedure, preserved context, replaced final turn, resampling model, automatic labeler, and product safety stack excluded from the estimate.

For monitorability research, separate the CoT monitor from the answer or task grader. Report CoT-only, action-only, and combined observations; label mismatch; class prevalence; CoT-length strata; monitor calibration; cross-fit split; and environment-level results. Recreate CoT-Control with explicit synthetic instruction templates and do not interpret low control as a formal non-steerability guarantee.

For agent and cyber evaluation, keep hidden tests, flags, pass@1, any-success, medal thresholds, expert rubrics, and policy compliance as distinct contracts. A public analogue should pin environments and tests, release failed traces, and compare learned graders with programmatic and human judgments.

For deployment audit, evaluate the topical classifier and safety-reasoner monitor separately, including false positives, false negatives, threshold drift, latency, appeal or manual-review pathways, and actor-level enforcement. These controls should never substitute for evidence about training data or model-only safety.

安全复用等级是 reading and audit reference only。本 Card 可作为四层模板：training intervention、evaluation record 与 scorer、monitorability infrastructure 和 deployment safeguard。每项主张都应保留所属层、日期、model/monitor checkpoint、sampling frame、environment、budget 和 terminal predicate。

对于 long-rollout data design，应构建包含 task/workspace revision、actor/change ownership、初始与中间 state、command/tool call、agent-authored change、simulated-user work、revert operation、final artifact、preservation/task-correctness predicate、reward component 和 failure label 的记录。还应发布 semantic test，以及“保留 diff 但破坏意图”的对抗样例。

对于 dynamic safety evaluation，应保留完整 multi-turn trajectory、simulator model 与 prompt、adaptive attack policy、per-message label、worst-case aggregation 和失败样例。对于 production-like resampling，应固定 traffic window、deidentification procedure、保留 context、被替换 final turn、resampling model、automatic labeler，以及估计中未包含的 product safety stack。

对于 monitorability 研究，应把 CoT monitor 与 answer/task grader 分开。报告 CoT-only、action-only 和 combined observation、label mismatch、class prevalence、CoT-length stratum、monitor calibration、cross-fit split 和 environment-level 结果。重建 CoT-Control 时应显式发布合成 instruction template，且不能将低 control 解释为形式化 non-steerability 保证。

对于 agent 与 cyber evaluation，应把 hidden test、flag、pass@1、any-success、medal threshold、expert rubric 和 policy compliance 保持为不同 contract。公开替代物应固定环境和测试，发布失败 trace，并比较 learned grader、programmatic judgment 和 human judgment。

对于部署审计，应分别评估 topical classifier 与 safety-reasoner monitor，包括假阳性、假阴性、threshold drift、latency、appeal/manual-review path 和 actor-level enforcement。这些控制绝不能替代训练数据或 model-only safety 的证据。

value.html: Training-source disclosure repeats three broad classes: public internet information, third-party partner-accessed information, and information provided or generated by users, human trainers, and researchers. GPT-5.4-specific training objects additionally include undisclosed long-rollout tasks with implicit simulated user work, platform and developer confirmation policies supplied through privileged messages, known prompt-injection attacks, and cyber safety scenarios. Evaluation-only prompts include hard production-derived conversations, adversarial dynamic conversations, deidentified recent GPT-5.2 traffic with final-turn resampling, CoT-Control benchmark problems, monitorability environments, hidden-test software tasks, held-out biological items, and cyber environments. Counts, source manifests, task identities, mixture weights, dates, and rights are unknown.

No serialized training schema is released. Disclosed records may contain conversation history, assistant messages, internal CoT, developer or system confirmation policy, workspace state, user and agent file changes, commands or tool calls, final response or artifact, policy labels, task-specific grader outputs, CoT-monitor labels, hidden-test results, flags, pass or fail outcomes, or human and expert rubric scores.

GPT-5.4 Thinking produces internal CoTs and agent action or tool trajectories. For long-rollout safety training, agents act in complex workspaces containing implicit simulated user work and are trained to revert their own changes while preserving that work; the simulated-user or work generator, retained traces, and selection are unknown. Evaluation traces include dynamically generated user-assistant safety conversations, resampled final turns, CoT-Control traces, monitorability rollouts, software and cyber episodes, and third-party audit transcripts. GPT-5 Thinking serves as the CoT monitor in the monitorability suite, not as a disclosed training reward.

value.html: Training substrate is mostly unknown; the report specifically implies changing workspaces for long-rollout self-reversion and computer-use contexts governed by platform or developer confirmation policy. Evaluation-only substrates include production-like conversations, simulated multi-turn safety interactions, connector and function-call prompt injection, 24 monitorability environments, CoT-Control tasks, browser and computer-use scenarios, pre-change monorepositories with command-line and Python tools and hidden tests, GPU Kaggle tasks, cyber sandboxes, headless tool boxes, emulated networks, and containers with internal code or run artifacts. Deployed cyber classifiers, system-message policies, access controls, and message or account blocking are safeguards rather than training environments.

Generic reasoning RL is disclosed, but its reward or verifier is unknown. Long-rollout self-reversion and preservation of simulated user work are stated training objectives without a disclosed detector, reward scale, aggregation, or terminal rule; confirmation and cyber training similarly disclose desired policy behavior but not feedback implementation. Evaluation contracts are separate: policy compliance and not_unsafe; automatic labels on resampled completions; task-specific answer graders; GPT-4o fairness grading; example-specific rubrics; GPT-5 Thinking CoT monitoring with g-mean-squared; CoT instruction following; hidden unit tests; flags and pass or fail; medal thresholds; pass@1; and expert or manual review. Deployment uses a topical classifier followed by a safety-reasoner monitor, which is not the training reward.

Training termination is unknown. Evaluation terminal conditions include checking every assistant message in a dynamic conversation, completing a resampled final turn, all hidden Monorepo-Bench tests passing, retrieving a cyber flag, at least one success across Cyber Range trials, pass@1 for CVE-Bench or OPQA, a bronze-medal threshold for MLE-Bench, and task-specific policy or rubric outcomes.

GPT-5.4 Thinking is a GPT-5-series reasoning model that incorporates frontier coding and computer-use capabilities. Architecture, parameter count, exact checkpoint, pretraining corpus, and stage allocation are unknown.
unknown

Adversarial user simulators generate varied dynamic safety trajectories, and implicit simulated user work is inserted into long-rollout workspaces; generator models, prompts, policies, versions, and sampling are unknown. The production-like evaluation resamples final turns with GPT-5.4 Thinking. These evaluation generators must not be assumed to generate training data unless explicitly stated.

Training sampling is unknown. Evaluation sampling includes deidentified conversations broadly representative of recent GPT-5.2 Thinking traffic with only the last turn resampled; dynamic adversarial conversations; more than 13,000 CoT-Control problem and instruction pairs; 13 monitorability evaluations across 24 environments; three CVE-Bench rollouts; 16 Cyber Range trials; selected 30-task MLE-Bench and held-out or non-public bio sets. Production-like estimates are point-in-time and subject to distribution and pipeline drift.

Training rollout counts are unknown, including for the long-rollout preservation intervention. Evaluation-only counts include three CVE-Bench rollouts, 16 Cyber Range trials per scenario, and third-party cyber runs with up to 1,000 turns; dynamic-conversation and production-like sample counts are not disclosed.
unknown

General training uses high-level quality and risk filtering, personal-information reduction, and safety classifiers without disclosed rules or yields. Evaluation filtering and sampling includes hard-case selection around prior failures, deidentification, classifier-flagged cyber cases, embedding clustering, MITRE ATT&CK coverage, narrow task subsets, and cross-fit filtering for monitorability. These evaluation procedures are not a training filtering recipe.

Training budgets are unknown. Evaluation and deployment settings include over 13,000 CoT-Control tasks stratified by CoT length, 1,000-turn external cyber episodes with compaction every 100K tokens, multiple reasoning-effort settings, and experimental 1M-context support in Codex. These are inference or evaluation disclosures, not a training rollout budget.

The report states that reasoning models use reinforcement learning and describes long-rollout self-reversion, confirmation-policy, prompt-injection, and cyber-safety training interventions. It does not disclose the RL algorithm, optimizer, reward or objective mixture, label production, batch sizes, rollout grouping, schedules, compute, checkpoint selection, or causal stage attribution.

The same three broad source classes as earlier GPT-5 reports are disclosed, without a GPT-5.4-specific manifest, mixture weights, sample or token counts, date ranges, revisions, consent handling, or source-level rights. Evaluation production traffic, simulated conversations, benchmark tasks, hidden tests, and cyber data must not substitute for the missing training mixture.

No global train, development, and test ledger is provided. Both connector and function-call prompt-injection evaluations are training-data splits. Cyber safety evaluation data are explicitly non-overlapping with training. SecureBio is fully held out and selected in-house biology sets are described as unpublished or uncontaminated. These statements are narrow and cannot be generalized across the corpus.

No global training-corpus, benchmark, code-repository, production-traffic, or environment overlap audit is disclosed. Prompt-injection overlap is affirmative; cyber non-overlap and selected bio held-out claims are scoped. Membership hashes, revision pins, contamination procedures, and false-negative audits are absent.

items: Training-source and reasoning-RL language repeats prior GPT-5 cards and adds no reward, verifier, optimizer, trace-retention, or quantitative mixture detail.

The long-rollout intervention names self-reversion and preservation of simulated user work but omits task sources, simulated-work generator, trajectory schema, counts, detector or reward, false positives, false negatives, and superficial preservation failure modes.
Dynamic adversarial conversations and production-like final-turn resampling are evaluations; treating them as safety-training trajectories would cross an unsupported boundary.

Production-like estimates are point-in-time, affected by traffic and pipeline drift, reconstruct only sampled context, measure model outputs without the full safety stack, and do not equal deployed prevalence.
Prompt-injection evaluations are splits of training data and cannot support generalization claims; the slight function-call regression also shows saturation does not eliminate attack-surface risk.

CoT monitorability depends on GPT-5 Thinking, task-specific or model answer graders, positive-sample counts, CoT length, and label alignment; Anti-Scheming and Memory were sufficiently problematic that OpenAI plans to drop them until revised.

CoT-Control uses synthetic format instructions paired with established benchmarks and is heavily confounded by CoT length; low controllability is an audit signal, not proof that reasoning cannot be hidden.

Hidden tests, flags, pass or fail, medal thresholds, programmatic tests, expert rubrics, policy graders, and automatic labels belong to distinct evaluations and are not evidence of RLVR or the training reward.
Cyber safety non-overlap applies only to that evaluation, whose production and synthetic mix is intentionally challenging and not representative of normal traffic.
The two-tier cyber conversation monitor, asynchronous blocks, actor enforcement, trusted access, and system-message policies are deployment controls and can change independently of model training.
The current PDF is mutable: its March 5 cover includes a March 17 mini appendix and an April 24 CoT update, so retrieval date and section revision are required for reproducibility.
No reusable data, weights, reward code, source-license ledger, global decontamination audit, or item-level lineage is released.
